traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Colchicaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins parallel; blades linear or lanceolate; leaf rosettes basal or none; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; stems herbaceous; flowers solitary, in cymes, in racemes or in umbels; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit capsule; parts of each whorl 3; stamens 6; carpels 3 (-4). Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.perennation.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Colchicaceae: how its perennial herbs last from year to year (character 25), coded usually a corm, rarely a rhizome. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py with character 25 added); states the authors do not qualify, side by side, read as often.
